Ui.Script:
-- UIOptionsFrame.xml loads first and owns the uvars; each row captures its default at -- OnLoad. -- Deviation: AUTO_QUEST_WATCH is the string "1". 1.12 assigns the number 1 (l.122) but -- every consumer compares against "1" (QuestLogFrame.lua:64/68); 1 ~= "1" in Lua 5.0. AUTO_QUEST_WATCH = "1" RegisterForSave("AUTO_QUEST_WATCH")
-- UIOptionsFrame.lua:370-376: Blizzard_CombatText is LoadOnDemand, so the master loads it. function CombatText_UpdateOrLoad() if ( SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT == "1" ) then UIParentLoadAddOn("Blizzard_CombatText") end if ( CombatText_UpdateDisplayedMessages ) then CombatText_UpdateDisplayedMessages() end end -- The Remove Chat Hover Delay row's applyFunc (UIOptionsFrame.lua:216). function ChatFrame_ApplyMouseOverDelay() if SetChatMouseOverDelay then -- nil in a VM loaded without the chat files SetChatMouseOverDelay(REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY) end end
-- Show Tutorials' setter (UIOptionsFrame.lua:318-327); there is no tutorial CVar. The `~=` -- guard is the reference's: re-ticking an on row must not re-arm dismissed tutorials. function BenillaOptionsFrame_SetTutorialsEnabled(value) if ( tonumber(value) ~= TutorialsEnabled() ) then if ( value == "1" ) then ResetTutorials() TutorialFrameCheckButton:SetChecked(1) else ClearTutorials() end TutorialFrame_HideAllAlerts() end end
-- UIOptionsFrame.lua:768-780. Deviation: stock l.776 is dropped. On 1.12 its show-then-hide -- clears volatile bits (`[0xc4da34]`); here the verbs write the CVar pair that is the -- store, so it would erase the saved setting at every world entry. function UpdateNameplates() if ( NAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowNameplates() else HideNameplates() end if ( FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowFriendNameplates() else HideFriendNameplates() end end
-- The category tree in list order; keys are the row name suffixes. OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS = { "Controls", "Interface", "ActionBars", "Combat", "Chat", "Keybindings", "Nameplates", "Graphics", "Audio", }
-- The era UIParent draws smaller than our 768-unit canvas; a chosen value, not the -- reference's. ERA_WINDOW_SCALE = 0.78
function BenillaOptionsFrame_UpdateScale() -- The era panel's checkFit: it also shrinks to fit the screen. local k = ERA_WINDOW_SCALE local wFit = GetScreenWidth() / 940 local hFit = GetScreenHeight() / 744 if wFit < k then k = wFit end if hFit < k then k = hFit end BenillaOptionsFrame:SetScale(k) end
-- The era tab width, label + 40, measured after OnShow sets the scale. function OptionsTab_FitWidth(tab) tab:SetWidth(getglobal(tab:GetName() .. "Text"):GetStringWidth() + 40) end
-- The wash at the era atlas size, in the 1.14 hover steel-blue. function OptionsCategoryRow_OnLoad(row, key, label) row.categoryKey = key row.pageTitle = label row:SetText(label) local bg = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Bg") bg:SetWidth(187) bg:SetHeight(21) bg:SetVertexColor(0.196, 0.388, 0.8) end
-- 1.14's OptionsList_SelectButton. SetText("") ends a search and re-enters here. function BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(key) BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory = key if BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:GetText() ~= "" then BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:SetText("") return -- the restore re-entered with this key and finished end for _, k in ipairs(OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k) local bg = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k .. "Bg") if k == key then bg:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 0) bg:Show() row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontHighlight") BenillaOptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText(row.pageTitle) else bg:SetVertexColor(0.196, 0.388, 0.8) bg:Hide() row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontNormal") end end for k in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local body = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k) if k == key then body:Show() else body:Hide() end end -- A category switch starts at the top, as the era ScrollBox does per category. BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0) -- Leaving Keybindings disarms a pending capture, which must never outlive the page. local kb = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindings") if key == "Keybindings" then kb:Show() KeyBindingsPage_Refresh() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Show() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Enable() else kb:Hide() KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Hide() if OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then OptionsPage_Refresh(key) BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Enable() else BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Disable() end end end
-- ── Search: the era SettingsPanel search ── -- Tags are labels uppercased, matched by plain substring and scored by matched length. -- Results are the live rows, so writes work mid-search.
function OptionsSearch_Words(text) local up = string.upper(text) local words = { up } for w in string.gfind(up, "([^, ]+)") do table.insert(words, w) end return words end
-- The era's MatchesSearchTags score, with a plain find. function OptionsSearch_Score(tag, words) for _, w in ipairs(words) do local first, last = string.find(tag, w, 1, true) if first then return last - first end end return nil end
function OptionsSearch_FindMatches(text) local words = OptionsSearch_Words(text) local buckets, scores = {}, {} for _, key in ipairs(OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do if OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) local s = OptionsSearch_Score(row.searchTag, words) if s then if not buckets[s] then buckets[s] = {} table.insert(scores, s) end table.insert(buckets[s], { key = key, rkey = rkey }) end end end end -- Keybinding matches join the buckets; their rkey is the binding index. for _, m in ipairs(KeyBindings_SearchMatches(words)) do if not buckets[m.score] then buckets[m.score] = {} table.insert(scores, m.score) end table.insert(buckets[m.score], { key = "Keybindings", rkey = m.index }) end table.sort(scores, function(a, b) return a > b end) local groups, order = {}, {} for _, s in ipairs(scores) do for _, m in ipairs(buckets[s]) do if not groups[m.key] then groups[m.key] = {} table.insert(order, m.key) end table.insert(groups[m.key], m.rkey) end end return order, groups end
-- ── The page scroll ── -- Only frames hung off the body's top are measured, so the size converges. function OptionsScroll_ContentBottom() local bottom = nil local function take(name) local f = getglobal(name) if f and f:IsVisible() then local b = f:GetBottom() if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end end end for _, key in ipairs(OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do if OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key) for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) end end end take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings") for i = 1, KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i) end return bottom end
-- From OnUpdate, off the previous frame's rects; SetWidth and SetHeight invalidate layout. function OptionsScroll_Fit() local sf = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll local body = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody local fw, fh = sf:GetWidth(), sf:GetHeight() if not fw or fw <= 0 or not fh or fh <= 0 then return end if math.abs(body:GetWidth() - fw) >= 0.5 then body:SetWidth(fw) end local h = fh local top, bottom = body:GetTop(), OptionsScroll_ContentBottom() if top and bottom then local content = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD if content > h then h = content end end if math.abs(body:GetHeight() - h) >= 0.5 then body:SetHeight(h) sf:UpdateScrollChildRect() end end
-- The era SettingsList layout: the head at (10,-12), each next at (0,-9), as in the XML. function OptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) local f = getglobal(name) f:ClearAllPoints() if prev then f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", prev, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -9) f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", prev, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, -9) else f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPLEFT", 10, -12) f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPRIGHT", -20, -12) end end
-- Back on the XML chain after a search; a test holds the two equal. function OptionsPage_Layout(key) local prev = nil for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey OptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) getglobal(name):Show() prev = name end end
-- The title and no-match strings are ours: the era's are not in its UI source. function OptionsSearch_Display(text) BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0) for k in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k):Show() for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[k]) do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k .. rkey):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindings"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide() for i = 1, KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide() end KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Hide() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText("Search Results") BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Hide()
local order, groups = OptionsSearch_FindMatches(text) if table.getn(order) == 0 then BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Show() return end BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide() local prev = nil for _, key in ipairs(order) do local head = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key OptionsSearch_Place(head, prev) getglobal(head):Show() prev = head if key == "Keybindings" then KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = {} local shown = 0 for _, index in ipairs(groups[key]) do if shown < KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS then shown = shown + 1 local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. shown KeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) OptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) getglobal(name):Show() KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted[name] = index prev = name end end else local placed = {} for _, rkey in ipairs(groups[key]) do local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) if row.parentRow and not placed[row.parentRow] then placed[row.parentRow] = 1 local pname = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. row.parentRow OptionsSearch_Place(pname, prev) getglobal(pname):Show() prev = pname end if not placed[rkey] then placed[rkey] = 1 local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey OptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) row:Show() prev = name end end OptionsPage_Refresh(key) end end end
function OptionsSearch_Restore() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0) for k in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do OptionsPage_Layout(k) getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide() end for i = 1, KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide() KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Show() BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory or "Controls") end
function OptionsSearch_OnTextChanged(text) if text == BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText then return end local had = BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText and BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText ~= "" BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText = text if text == "" then if had then OptionsSearch_Restore() end else OptionsSearch_Display(text) end end
-- ── The setting pages: 1.12 rows in the era Settings grammar ── -- Descriptions 1.12 lacks take a BENILLA_ prefix. BENILLA_TOOLTIP_RENDER_SCALE = "Draws the 3D world at a fraction of the window's resolution, or larger than it. " .. "The interface is unaffected at any setting.\n\n" .. "Below 100% trades sharpness for frame rate; above 100% is supersampling, which " .. "smooths edges at the cost of frame rate. Applies when you click Apply."

"With this off, switching away silences the game and switching back restores it. " .. "Sounds keep running while they are silenced, so a long one may have finished by " .. "the time you return."

Controls = { "RowStickyTarget", "RowAssistAttack", "RowClearAFK", "RowBlockTrades", "RowAutoSelfCast", "RowAutoLoot", "RowInvertMouse", "RowMouseSpeed", "RowCameraFollowStyle", "RowFollowTerrain", "RowHeadBob", "RowAutoFollowSpeed", "RowWaterCollision", "RowSmartPivot", "RowMouseLookSpeed", "RowMaxCameraDistance", }, Audio = { "RowEnableAll", "RowMaster", "RowSound", "RowMusic", "RowAmbience", "RowEnableMusic", "RowEnableAmbience", "RowEnableErrorSpeech", "RowBackgroundSound", }, Graphics = { "RowUiScale", "RowFarclip", "RowWorldDetail", "RowBrightness", "RowWeatherDensity", "RowDisplayMode", "RowVerticalSync", "RowRenderScale", }, -- Guild Names is a child of Player Names (UIOptionsFrame.lua:703-709). Not shipped: Simple Chat, which needs -- FCF_Set_SimpleChat's re-layout, Lock Chat Settings and Guild Recruitment. Chat = { "RowGuildMemberAlert", "RowRemoveChatDelay", "RowChatBubbles", "RowLootSpam", "RowPartyChatBubbles", "RowSpamFilter", }, -- Deviation: the bar toggles precede the lock, which 1.12's box leads with, so what is -- on screen reads first. Combat = { "RowCombatText", "RowFloatMode", "RowLowHealthMana", "RowAuras", "RowAuraFade", "RowCombatState", "RowDodgeParryMiss", "RowResistances", "RowReputation", "RowReactives", "RowFriendlyNames", "RowComboPoints", "RowEnergyGains", "RowHonorGained", -- Under their own master (UIOptionsFrame.lua:710-716). "RowShowDamage", "RowPeriodicDamage", "RowPetDamage", }, }
-- `tip` is a GlobalStrings key, resolved at hover as UIOptionsFrame.lua:265 does. function OptionsRow_OnLoad(row, cvar, label, tip, child) row.cvar = cvar row.tip = tip row.searchTag = string.upper(label) -- OptionsRow_SetEnabled's disabled font must keep the child size. row.child = child local l = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Label") l:SetText(label) if child then l:SetFontObject("GameFontNormalSmall") l:ClearAllPoints() l:SetPoint("LEFT", row:GetName(), "LEFT", 52, 0) l:SetPoint("RIGHT", row:GetName(), "CENTER", -85, 0) end end
-- ── The row's store ── -- 1.12's `cvar`, `uvar` or `func`/`setFunc` (UIOptionsFrame.lua:230-377), all strings. Keep -- OptionsRow_HasStore in OptionsRow_Set's order. function OptionsRow_HasStore(row) return row.uvar or row.setFunc or row.cvar end
function OptionsRow_Get(row) if row.uvar then return getglobal(row.uvar) end if row.getFunc then -- OptionsFrame.lua:110/135, formatted like the slider's write so strings compare -- equal. if row.numeric then return (string.gsub(string.format("%.2f", row.getFunc()), "%.?0+$", "")) end if row.getFunc() then return "1" else return "0" end end return GetCVar(row.cvar) end
-- A uvar row applies on the click; `cvarEvent` is CVAR_UPDATE's arg1. function OptionsRow_Set(row, value) if row.uvar then setglobal(row.uvar, value) -- Looked up when applied: most definers load after this file. local apply = row.applyFunc if type(apply) == "string" then apply = getglobal(apply) end if apply then apply() end return end -- The "1"/"0" string, as UIOptionsFrame.lua:291-297. if row.setFunc then -- A number, as OptionsFrame.lua:206-226. if row.numeric then row.setFunc(tonumber(value)) else row.setFunc(value) end return end SetCVar(row.cvar, value, row.cvarEvent) OptionsRow_WritePartner(row, value) end
-- UIOptionsFrame_Save's partner writes: Pet Melee Damage also writes PetSpellDamage -- (l.334-336); the camera speeds write their pitch twin at yaw/4 and yaw/2 (l.351-356). function OptionsRow_WritePartner(row, value) if not row.partner then return end local v = value if row.partner.scale then v = string.gsub( string.format("%.2f", tonumber(value) * row.partner.scale), "%.?0+$", "") end SetCVar(row.partner.cvar, v) end
-- A uvar's default is captured at OnLoad, before the saved-variables chunk runs. function OptionsRow_Default(row) if row.uvar then return row.udefault end if row.getFunc then return row.fdefault end return GetCVarDefault(row.cvar) end
-- OptionsRow_OnLoad's signature with the global's name in the cvar seat. function OptionsGlobalRow_OnLoad(row, uvar, label, tip, child) OptionsRow_OnLoad(row, nil, label, tip, child) row.uvar = uvar row.udefault = getglobal(uvar) end
-- Stated, as UIOptionsFrame_SetDefaults hand-writes it (l.631-634). function OptionsFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child) OptionsRow_OnLoad(row, nil, label, tip, child) row.getFunc = getFunc row.setFunc = setFunc row.fdefault = default end
-- `default` is still a string, since rows compare strings. function OptionsNumFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child) OptionsFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child) row.numeric = 1 end
-- UIOptionsFrame.lua:193-227 re-applies saved uvars, so this window has no load ladder.
-- OptionsFrameSliders is the stock table (OptionsFrame.lua:24-34), which addons write. -- Holes at 4, 5, 7 and 8, so the OnShow loop uses the pairs form: ipairs would stop at 3. BENILLA_GRAPHICS_SLIDER_ROWS = { "RowUiScale", "RowFarclip", "RowWorldDetail", [6] = "RowBrightness", [9] = "RowWeatherDensity", }
-- SetMinMaxValues re-clamps and fires OnValueChanged, which must not write back. function OptionsSliderRow_Setup(row, min, max, step, fmt, stops) local slider = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "ControlSlider") row.fmt = fmt -- Kept for the "travel" readout, a share of the row's own range. row.minv, row.maxv = min, max -- Deviation: a named ladder reads out its stop; 1.12's slider labels only its ends, and -- a bare index would mean nothing to a player. row.stops = stops row.refreshing = 1 slider:SetMinMaxValues(min, max) slider:SetValueStep(step) row.refreshing = nil end
-- ── The dropdown rows: the 1.12 UIDropDownMenu kit ── function OptionsDropdownRow_Setup(row, entries) row.entries = entries local dd = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Dropdown") UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(180, dd) UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(dd, OptionsDropdownRow_InitMenu) -- The capsule's button steals hover from the row, so it carries the row wash too. local btn = getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button") btn:SetScript("OnEnter", function() OptionsRow_Hover(this:GetParent():GetParent(), 1) end) btn:SetScript("OnLeave", function() OptionsRow_Hover(this:GetParent():GetParent(), nil) end) end
function OptionsDropdownRow_InitMenu() local dd = getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_INIT_MENU) local row = dd:GetParent() for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do local info = {} info.text = e.text info.value = e.value info.func = OptionsDropdownEntry_OnClick UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
-- `this` is the list button; the kit closes the list and plays the click. function OptionsDropdownEntry_OnClick() local dd = UIDropDownMenu_GetCurrentDropDown() local row = dd:GetParent() OptionsRow_Set(row, this.value) OptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row) end
-- A field, not SetSelectedValue, whose Refresh walks the shared DropDownList1. An off-grid -- value shows the nearest entry. function OptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row) local dd = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Dropdown") local v = OptionsRow_Get(row) local match for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do -- `alt`: a stored "3" shows as Never, where the nearest value would show Always. if e.value == v or (e.alt ~= nil and e.alt == v) then match = e end end if not match and tonumber(v) then local best for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do local d = tonumber(e.value) and math.abs(tonumber(e.value) - tonumber(v)) if d and (not best or d < best) then best = d match = e end end end if match then dd.selectedValue = match.value UIDropDownMenu_SetText(match.text, dd) -- As UIOptionsFrameCameraDropDown_OnClick retargets OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA<id>. if match.tip then row.tip = match.tip end else dd.selectedValue = v UIDropDownMenu_SetText(v, dd) end end
function OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value) if row.fmt == "raw" then return string.format("%d", math.floor(value + 0.5)) end -- The clamp guards a short stops table. if row.stops then local i = math.floor(value + 0.5) + 1 if i < 1 then i = 1 end if i > table.getn(row.stops) then i = table.getn(row.stops) end return row.stops[i] end -- "travel": the thumb's share of the groove. Brightness stores the reference's -- `1 - gamma` (-0.5 to +0.5, default 0) and reads 0 to 100% with the default at 50. if row.fmt == "travel" and row.minv and row.maxv and row.maxv > row.minv then return string.format("%d%%", math.floor((value - row.minv) / (row.maxv - row.minv) * 100 + 0.5)) end -- "yards": cameraDistanceMaxFactor over the 15 yd base. if row.fmt == "yards" then return string.format("%d yd", math.floor(value * 15 + 0.5)) end return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) end
-- Crossing controls does not blink: OnLeave fires before OnEnter within a move. function OptionsRow_Hover(row, on) local hover = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Hover") if on then hover:Show() OptionsRow_ShowTooltip(row) else hover:Hide() GameTooltip:Hide() end end
-- 1.12's per-option string alone in gold (OptionsFrameTemplates.xml:52-64). function OptionsRow_ShowTooltip(row) local text = row.tip and getglobal(row.tip) if text then GameTooltip:SetOwner(getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Tip"), "ANCHOR_RIGHT", -10, 0) GameTooltip:SetText(text, nil, nil, nil, nil, 1) else -- Deviation: 1.12 returns early here; a mute row hides the last plate, so a -- neighbour's text cannot stand when its OnLeave was missed. GameTooltip:Hide() end end
function OptionsCheckbox_OnClick(box) local row = box:GetParent() local checked = box:GetChecked() -- The 1.12 panels disagree: the interface panel plays CheckBoxOn when checked -- (OptionsFrame.lua:509-515), the sound panel CheckBoxOff; Audio rows carry soundQuirk. local kitOn = checked if row.soundQuirk then kitOn = not kitOn end if kitOn then PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") else PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") end -- An inverted row (Sticky Targeting, Disable Spam Filter) writes the opposite. local on = checked if row.invert then on = not on end if on then OptionsRow_Set(row, "1") else OptionsRow_Set(row, "0") end OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory) end
function OptionsSlider_OnValueChanged(slider, value) local control = slider:GetParent() local row = control:GetParent() if not row.refreshing then -- Snaps to the grid from the minimum (farclip's is 177+n*60); a refresh sets it -- raw. local step = slider:GetValueStep() if step and step > 0 then local minv = slider:GetMinMaxValues() local snapped = minv + math.floor((value - minv) / step + 0.5) * step if math.abs(snapped - value) > 0.00001 then slider:SetValue(snapped) -- re-enters once with the snapped value return end value = snapped -- the clean grid number, not the f32-rounded echo end end getglobal(control:GetName() .. "Value"):SetText(OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value)) if OptionsRow_HasStore(row) and not row.refreshing then -- Trailing zeros stripped, so a value at its default stays out of the config file. local str = string.gsub(string.format("%.2f", value), "%.?0+$", "") if row.deferred then -- Stored on Apply; a pending equal to the committed value is dropped. if str == OptionsRow_Get(row) then row.pending = nil else row.pending = str end OptionsApply_Update() else OptionsRow_Set(row, str) end end end
function OptionsPage_Refresh(key) local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) local box = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "Check") if box then -- "0" unchecks; an inverted row checks on "0". if row.invert then local checked if OptionsRow_Get(row) == "0" then checked = 1 end box:SetChecked(checked) else box:SetChecked(OptionsRow_Get(row)) end elseif row.entries then OptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row) else local slider = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlSlider") row.refreshing = 1 -- A staged value shows first, as the era's GetValue returns it. slider:SetValue(tonumber(row.pending or OptionsRow_Get(row) or "0") or 0) row.refreshing = nil -- SetValue fires only on a change, so the readout is written here. getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlValue"):SetText( OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, slider:GetValue())) end end OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key) OptionsApply_Update() end
-- Each page's dependency rules, the 1.12 panel's own. function OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key) if key == "Combat" then -- Combo Points is for rogues and druids only. local on = SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT ~= "0" local _, class = UnitClass("player") class = class and string.upper(class) local combo = class == "ROGUE" or class == "DRUID" -- The damage-number trio is not under this master. local damage = { RowShowDamage = 1, RowPeriodicDamage = 1, RowPetDamage = 1, } for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS.Combat) do if rkey ~= "RowCombatText" and not damage[rkey] then local live = on if rkey == "RowComboPoints" and not combo then live = nil end OptionsRow_SetEnabled( getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombat" .. rkey), live) end end -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:710-716: Show Target Damage off greys Periodic and Pet Damage. local dmg = GetCVar("CombatDamage") ~= "0" OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombatRowPeriodicDamage, dmg) OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombatRowPetDamage, dmg) return end if key == "Controls" then -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:717-721: dead while the style is Never, "0" or a stray "3". local style = GetCVar("cameraSmoothStyle") OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyControlsRowAutoFollowSpeed, style ~= "0" and style ~= "3") return end if key == "Nameplates" then -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:703-709: Player Names off greys Player Guild Names. OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNameplatesRowGuildNames, GetCVar("UnitNamePlayer") ~= "0") return end if key == "Interface" then -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:697-701: the mode is dead while its switch is off. OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyInterfaceRowTargetOfTargetMode, SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET ~= "0") return end if key == "ActionBars" then -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:722-726: Right ActionBar 2 needs Right ActionBar. OptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyActionBarsRowMultiBar4, SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_3) return end if key ~= "Audio" then return end -- SoundOptionsFrame_UpdateDependencies; Enable Music stays live, as in 1.12. local on = GetCVar("MasterSoundEffects") ~= "0" for _, row in {"RowEnableAmbience", "RowEnableErrorSpeech"} do local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyAudio"..row.."Check") local label = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyAudio"..row.."Label") if on then box:Enable() label:SetFontObject("GameFontNormal") else box:Disable() label:SetFontObject("GameFontDisable") end end end
-- As OptionsFrame_DisableDropDown; 1.12 has no UIDropDownMenu_DisableDropDown. function OptionsRow_SetEnabled(row, on) local name = row:GetName() local box = getglobal(name .. "Check") local dd = getglobal(name .. "Dropdown") -- As OptionsFrame_DisableSlider (l.481-486); a press on the track would seat the value. local sl = getglobal(name .. "ControlSlider") if box then if on then box:Enable() else box:Disable() end elseif sl then local thumb = getglobal(name .. "ControlSliderThumb") local value = getglobal(name .. "ControlValue") if on then sl:EnableMouse(true) thumb:Show() value:SetTextColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) else sl:EnableMouse(false) thumb:Hide() value:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) end elseif dd then local text = getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Text") if on then getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button"):Enable() text:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) else getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button"):Disable() text:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) end end local label = getglobal(name .. "Label") if on then label:SetFontObject(row.child and "GameFontNormalSmall" or "GameFontNormal") else label:SetFontObject(row.child and "GameFontDisableSmall" or "GameFontDisable") end end
-- Pending edits dropped. function OptionsPage_Defaults(key) local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) row.pending = nil OptionsRow_Set(row, OptionsRow_Default(row)) end OptionsPage_Refresh(key) end
-- ── The Apply flow ── -- Pending edits survive a category switch; hiding discards them.
function OptionsApply_Update() local pending for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do if getglobal(base .. rkey).pending then pending = 1 end end end if pending then BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Enable() BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Show() else BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Disable() BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Hide() end end
function OptionsPage_Apply() for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) if row.pending then OptionsRow_Set(row, row.pending) row.pending = nil end end end OptionsApply_Update() end
function OptionsPage_DiscardPending() for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do getglobal(base .. rkey).pending = nil end end OptionsApply_Update() end
